results.question: Vergleiche Lebensmittel und Essengehen pro Quartal 2025 als gruppierte Balken.
results.sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME(
    '%Y-Q',
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3
      THEN '1'
      WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6
      THEN '2'
      WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9
      THEN '3'
      ELSE '4'
    END,
    booked_on
  ) AS quarter,
  COALESCE(category, 'Needs review') AS topic,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
  AND (
    COALESCE(category, '') = 'Groceries' OR COALESCE(category, '') = 'Dining'
  )
  AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY
  quarter,
  topic
ORDER BY
  quarter,
  total_eur DESC
LIMIT 200
notes: request: Vergleich der Ausgaben für Lebensmittel und Essengehen pro Quartal 2025 als gruppierte Balken.

results.question: Draw a sankey of how my 2025 spending flows from its categories into their subcategories.
results.sql:
SELECT
  T1.category AS category,
  T2.subcategory AS subcategory,
  ROUND(-SUM(T1.amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view AS T1
INNER JOIN transaction_view AS T2
  ON T1.id = T2.id
WHERE
  T1.account <> T2.account
  AND NOT T1.category IS NULL
  AND NOT T2.subcategory IS NULL
GROUP BY
  T1.category,
  T2.subcategory
ORDER BY
  T1.category,
  T2.subcategory
LIMIT 200

results.question: Wie haben sich meine Ausgaben im Jahr 2025 Quartal fuer Quartal aufsummiert? Zeig mir den Verlauf.
results.sql:
SELECT
  STRFTIME('%Y', booked_on) || '-' || CASE
    WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) <= 3
    THEN 'Q1'
    WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) <= 6
    THEN 'Q2'
    WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) <= 9
    THEN 'Q3'
    ELSE 'Q4'
  END AS quarter,
  ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE
  amount < 0
GROUP BY
  quarter
ORDER BY
  quarter
LIMIT 200
notes: request: Aufsummierten Ausgaben pro Quartal für das Jahr 2025 im Verlauf
